scope:
Independent matrix audit and retained-state controls for the benchmark.

No production SCCG modules are imported. Inputs are the lossless RASSI NPZ
exports and archived JSON manifolds. All truncations keep the original five-root
orbitals, spin-free solutions, energies and operators; only state interaction
is changed. Output includes full curves, root-by-root influence, a conditional
decoupling/deletion path, matching diagnostics, and zero-coupling-node checks.

definitions.ranked_TV: Half L1 distance between descending-sorted normalized p vectors, padded with zeros; compares concentration profiles, not state identity
definitions.omitted_parentage: sum of full-manifold SO squared coefficients on omitted spin-free/Ms basis; weighted q/r/p fractions are soft parentage measures, not unique deleted nodes
definitions.decoupling_path: Zero retained-omitted H_SO blocks at full dimension, rediagonalize and transform dipoles; then remove omitted sector. Conditional nonlinear changes, not additive attribution
definitions.frozen_node_rule: Delete exactly as many full SO nodes as omitted spin-projection components, choosing greatest omitted-root parentage; freeze energies/dipoles/projectors, then recontract and normalize

energy_projector_retention_rule.scope: Select already diagonalized SO eigenstates at a common absolute energy; no rediagonalization
